title: Entitled Lady Thinks They're No Consequences For Her Nasty Attitude
description:
On April 9th, 2024. Employees from a car wash called 911, regarding a woman was demanding more free samples from the employees even after receiving some already. The lady then barges out of the store with the items she stole, which was just $10. Police arrived to let her know she's being trespassed and she should leave, however she was convinced she was above the law.
